mapper.sql: c.char_id, c.char_type, c.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, c.proc_id, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, c.char_no, c.char_nm, c.data_type, c.unit_cd, c.unit_nm, c.scale, c.nominal, c.lsl, c.usl, c.special_cls, c.source, c.drawing_no, c.drawing_rev, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, c.updated_at, c.updated_by
from qms_char c left join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = c.proc_id

where.if: and (c.char_nm ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\' or i.item_nm ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\' or c.char_no ilike #{q.keywordLike} escape '\')

mapper.sql:
order by
coalesce(i.item_cd, '') c.sort_no, c.char_no c.char_nm c.special_cls c.updated_at
desc,
c.char_id
mapper.select: select limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}
select count(*)
select
select where c.char_id = #{id}

insert into qms_char (comp_cd, char_type, item_id, proc_id, char_no, char_nm, data_type, unit_cd, unit_nm, scale, nominal, lsl, usl, special_cls, source, drawing_no, drawing_rev, sort_no, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.charType}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.procId}, #{f.charNo}, #{f.charNm}, #{f.dataType}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.unitNm}, #{f.scale}, #{f.nominal}, #{f.lsl}, #{f.usl}, #{f.specialCls}, #{f.source}, #{f.drawingNo}, #{f.drawingRev}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning char_id
mapper.update: update qms_char set proc_id = #{f.procId}, char_no = #{f.charNo}, char_nm = #{f.charNm}, data_type = #{f.dataType}, unit_cd = #{f.unitCd}, unit_nm = #{f.unitNm}, scale = #{f.scale}, nominal = #{f.nominal}, lsl = #{f.lsl}, usl = #{f.usl}, special_cls = #{f.specialCls}, source = #{f.source}, drawing_no = #{f.drawingNo}, drawing_rev = #{f.drawingRev}, sort_no = #{f.sortNo}, use_yn = #{f.useYn}, remark = #{f.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where char_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer}
mapper.select: select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, spec, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}
select proc_id, proc_cd, proc_nm, use_yn from mst_proc where proc_cd = #{procCd}
select proc_id, proc_cd, proc_nm, use_yn from mst_proc where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, proc_cd
select exists (select 1 from sys_code where grp_cd = #{grp} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y') or exists (select 1 from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = #{grp} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y')
mapper.sql: defect_id, defect_cd, defect_nm, cat_cd, sort_no, use_yn, remark, row_ver, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select:
select order by
(select k.sort_no from sys_code k where k.grp_cd = 'DEFECT_CAT' and k.code = d.cat_cd) d.defect_cd d.defect_nm d.sort_no d.updated_at
desc,
d.defect_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select from qms_defect where defect_id = #{id}

insert into qms_defect (comp_cd, defect_cd, defect_nm, cat_cd, sort_no, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.defectCd}, #{f.defectNm}, #{f.catCd}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning defect_id

select t.term_cd, t.category, t.term_ko, t.term_en, t.def_ko, t.def_en, (select count(*) from mst_term_alias a where a.term_cd = t.term_cd and a.use_yn = 'Y') as alias_cnt from sys_term t order by t.sort_no, t.term_cd
mapper.sql:
from sys_term t
and (t.term_cd ilike #{kw} escape '\' or t.term_ko ilike #{kw} escape '\' or t.term_en ilike #{kw} escape '\' or exists (select 1 from mst_term_alias a where a.term_cd = t.term_cd and a.use_yn = 'Y' and a.alias ilike #{kw} escape '\'))
mapper.select:
select t.term_cd, t.category, t.term_ko, t.term_en, t.def_ko, t.def_en, (select count(*) from mst_term_alias a where a.term_cd = t.term_cd and a.use_yn = 'Y') as alias_cnt
order by
t.category t.term_cd t.term_ko t.term_en alias_cnt t.sort_no
desc,
t.term_cd limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select exists (select 1 from sys_term where term_cd = #{termCd})
mapper.sql: alias_id, term_cd, alias, lang, use_yn, row_ver, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: select from mst_term_alias where term_cd = #{termCd} order by use_yn desc, alias
select from mst_term_alias where alias_id = #{id}
insert into mst_term_alias (comp_cd, term_cd, alias, lang, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.termCd}, #{f.alias}, #{f.lang}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning alias_id
